newsitem.title: SPAIN: Majorca coach crash kills British tourist, driver.
newsitem.headline: Majorca coach crash kills British tourist, driver.

text.p: Two people died and 47 were injured early on Friday on the Spanish island of Majorca when a car was in a head-on collision with a bus driving British tourists back to hotels after a night out, police said.
The two dead were the 22-year-old Spanish driver of the car and a British woman named as Dawn Mari Parker, 30. Three of the injured were in critical condition.
Police said the crash occurred about 1 a.m. when the car swerved out of its lane.
Rescue operations were hindered by darkness and difficulties in reaching the site of the accident. A large crane was needed to lift the bus and rescue passengers trapped inside.
